/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/alwida-alwida-ya-shaheed-be-khta-naz-dsht-nino.md'
current = Path(p).read_bytes()
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p])
start = current.index(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n')
end = current.index(b'\\n---\\n', start)
assert current[:start] + current[end + 1:] == original
roman = current[start:end].decode().split('\\n', 1)[1]
body = current[end + 5:].decode()
r = [s.splitlines() for s in roman.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
b = [s.splitlines() for s in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert len(r) == len(b) == 14
for i, (transcription, source) in enumerate(zip(r, b), 1):
    assert int(transcription[0]) == int(source[0]) == i
    assert len(transcription) == len(source)
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman)
print(f'14 stanzas, {sum(len(s)-1 for s in r)} verses, original bytes preserved')
PY"
